'''Ryale Wei''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] of the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] hoped to eventually become [[Pirate Queen/Legends|Pirate Queen]] herself, and often took credit for the actions of the current Pirate Queen, [[Noira]].<ref name="Mask of the Pirate Queen" />
